answer: Witness-Gated Challenge Relay. Each identity must solve a fresh, unpublished challenge whose answer commits to a live agent's secret state, then relay it via a randomly assigned terrace of relays that verify uniqueness on-chain. Because answers embed unpredictable context, copies fail validation at the ivory checkpoint. Attackers pay a distinct compute and latency cost per identity, plus forfeited knoll deposits on replay, making mass identity creation linear in real work.
